items.title: Apple proposes to take a 15% cut of purchases made outside the App Store
items.content: Apple is asking a federal judge to allow it to charge commissions of up to 15% on purchases made through external links in iOS apps.

items.title: If Apple sends you a push notification alerting you to a spyware attack, take it seriously
items.content: Apple now sends out push notifications to iPhone lock screens when the company identifies government spyware targeting someone's devices.

items.title: Apple in talks to pay publishers to provide Siri with current news: report
items.content: The tech giant has considered a nine-figure budget for the payments, according to the WSJ.

items.title: Block Blast! goes ad-free on Apple Arcade
items.content: Block Blast!, the most downloaded mobile game of 2025, is coming to Apple Arcade in September, where it will be ad-free.

items.title: Hyperscalers might regret embracing natural gas if new forecast proves correct
items.content: Natural gas prices could triple in some parts of the U.S., which could saddle hyperscalers with massive bills to power their AI data centers.

items.title: Microsoft kills off unsuccessful AI features while merging its separate Copilot apps
items.content: Microsoft is simplifying Copilot by combining its consumer and business apps, and dropping AI-generated podcasts, Group Chats, Deep Research, and its Mico character.

items.title: After Microsoft threatened legal action, a security researcher publishes a new Windows zero-day bug
items.content: This is the latest zero-day released by security researcher Nightmare Eclipse, despite Microsoft publicly threatening to take legal action against them.

items.title: Microsoft is openly competing with OpenAI, Anthropic more than ever
items.content: Microsoft pitched its own homegrown AI models, harnesses, and even a Mythos competitor on Wednesday, telling Wall Street it plans for continued growth.

items.title: The Cutthroat Wearables Battle Is About More Than Tracking Your Fitness
items.content: Google, Apple, Samsung and upstarts like Oura are racing to integrate data from their wearable devices into the health care system.

items.title: Sports Team Sale Prices Keep Hitting New Highs
items.content: This week’s deal for the Los Angeles Lakers, which valued the team at a record $12.5 billion, was the latest in a pattern of skyrocketing prices.

items.title: Worker Pay Isn’t Keeping Up With Inflation Once Again
items.content: When prices spiked in 2021-22, wages failed to keep up for many workers, new research shows. Now the pattern is repeating.

items.title: How to Protect Your Home While You’re on Vacation
items.content: Store food in sealed containers and fix any leaking faucets or pipes, experts told our columnist, who had her own nightmare upon returning home.
